R00.name: Beginner Corporation
R00.scene: A modest prefabricated habitat module with a single glowing window, a small rover parked beside it and a few hydroponic tents, centred on an open plain.

R08.name: CrediCor
R08.scene: A massive, gleaming gold vault stands in the center of a red desert, its heavy doors slightly ajar, revealing a blinding, radiant light from within the depths.

R17.name: Ecoline
R17.scene: A massive glass dome housing a dense, vertical jungle of greenery, with a lone suited figure standing on a central walkway overlooking the lush canopy below.

R18.name: Helion
R18.scene: A massive, glowing orange reactor core pulses with intense energy at the center of a dark, industrial space station, surrounded by intricate piping and metallic structures.

R19.name: Interplanetary Cinematics
R19.scene: A vast, circular glass dome on the Martian surface, its curved walls reflecting the red sky. Inside, rows of empty cinema seats face a massive blank screen, surrounded by polished steel corridors.

R43.name: Inventrix
R43.scene: A sleek, spherical laboratory station floats in the center, featuring a complex array of glass domes and metallic arms. It hovers above a flat, reddish Martian plain under a dim, hazy sky.

R24.name: Mining Guild
R24.scene: Massive industrial fortress complex with towering steel silos and active drilling rigs, centered against a stark Martian horizon.

R09.name: PhoboLog
R09.scene: A towering titanium refinery with gleaming metallic pipes and industrial machinery, set against the reddish Martian landscape under a star-filled sky.

R31.name: Tharsis Republic
R31.scene: A colossal, terraced administrative complex rises from the red dunes, its geometric tiers glowing with soft amber light under a dusty sky.

R13.name: ThorGate
R13.scene: A towering, angular reactor core radiates pulsing amber light from the center of a dark, industrial landscape. Massive conduits snake into the ground, emphasizing the facility's immense energy output and heavy industrial presence.

R32.name: United Nations Mars Initiative
R32.scene: A sleek, white orbital elevator tethered to a rocky Martian ridge, rising into a thin blue sky.

R03.name: Saturn Systems
R03.scene: A massive, ringed gas giant looms in the background, its pale bands swirling with atmospheric storms. In the foreground, a sleek titanium-hulled research station orbits silently, reflecting the planet's soft, hazy light.

R30.name: Teractor
R30.scene: A gleaming Earth-funded spaceport tower at the centre, a shuttle lifting off beside it on a pillar of light, with a small blue Earth hanging in the sky above.

R10.name: Point Luna
R10.scene: A lunar mining base on the grey Moon at Earth-rise, titanium ore haulers beside a tall launch tower, the blue Earth hanging large above the horizon.

R16.name: Cheung Shing MARS
R16.scene: A tall crane lowers a gleaming habitat module onto a half-built tower city on the Martian plains at dusk, welding sparks glowing, dust drifting across the scene.

R27.name: Robinson Industries
R27.scene: A balanced industrial complex on a Martian plateau: a small refinery, a greenhouse dome, solar arrays and a power plant arranged in a neat ring.

R34.name: Valley Trust
R34.scene: A research campus nestled in a deep Martian canyon, glass laboratories stepping down the cliff walls with soft light, a river of fog along the valley floor.

R35.name: Vitor
R35.scene: A gleaming white headquarters spire on a Martian mesa at dusk, terraces of greenhouses around its base and beams of light rising into the sky.
